Builds high-performance systems using monolithic and hybrid architectures. Experience with MPA + SSR and SPA architectures, CI/CD, and SQL/NoSQL databases. At York University UIT LTS, works on AI-driven backends including RAG systems, embeddings pipelines, and AI response tuning.
